description:
NativeLowerer (src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs:74-) keeps
`callable_boundaries: Vec<NativeCallableBoundary>` beside its mutable
state and walks it with `for boundary in self.callable_boundaries.clone()`
(native.rs:298) to call lower_callable_construction_wrapper(&mut self, ..).
The field is moved out whole at native.rs:350.

Also native.rs:741 `self.extern_marshals.get(&index).cloned()
.unwrap_or_default()` -- a Vec<ExternTy> copied per extern call lowered.

Change: same idea as .2 -- the list being walked is not part of the state
the walk mutates. Before building: establish whether
lower_callable_construction_wrapper can append to callable_boundaries
during the walk (if it can, the walk is a worklist and should be written
as one; if it cannot, the borrow splits).

Removal ledger: the Vec clone at :298, the marshal-plan clone at :741 if
the borrow splits the same way.

Signal: gate green, no golden/census/pin movement.
title: An extern call borrows its marshal plan
